description: Sub-box SHA rule: the closeout check requires a commit SHA on top-level task lines only. An indented [x] sub-box is covered when its nearest parent [x] line has a SHA. Unticked boxes still fail at every depth, except deferred lines. The status command's archive-candidate list uses the same function (PM request, 2026-11-18)
